scope: Diagnostic synthetic controls; not a prevalence sample, fidelity result, accessibility or conformance certificate.
compile_expectation_scope: Source intent with required dependencies installed; measured outcomes are recorded separately.

cases.title: Fraction control
expected_content: One fraction; numerator a+b; denominator c-d; subtraction stays in denominator.
cases.reader_task: Enter the denominator and identify its operator.
cases.expected_answer: c minus d; subtraction.

cases.title: Nested fractions
expected_content: Three fraction nodes. Outer numerator is 1+a/b; outer denominator c+d/e.
The inner denominator e belongs to d/e, not to the outer fraction.
cases.reader_task: Navigate to the denominator of the fraction inside the outer denominator.
cases.expected_answer: e.

cases.title: Script inside an exponent
expected_content: x has one superscript whose content is a with subscript b.
b attaches to a; x has no direct subscript.
cases.reader_task: Whose subscript is b?
cases.expected_answer: a, inside the exponent of x.

cases.title: Scripts on the same base
expected_content: x has superscript a and subscript b.
This structure differs from M03.
cases.reader_task: Whose subscript is b?
cases.expected_answer: x; a is the superscript of the same x.

cases.title: Tensor index placement
expected_content: Upper index mu; lower indices nu then rho.
Order and upper/lower position survive; no assumption about a particular metric or tensor meaning.
cases.reader_task: List the upper index and ordered lower indices.
cases.expected_answer: Upper mu; lower nu, rho.

cases.title: Complex matrix coordinates
expected_content: 2 rows and 3 columns.
cases.reader_task: Visit row 1 column 3, then row 2 column 1.
cases.expected_answer: Negative i, then i.

cases.title: Integral with limits
expected_content: Lower limit 0; upper limit infinity; variable t.
The exponent is the negative product alpha times t.
cases.reader_task: Read the integration limits and exponent.
cases.expected_answer: 0 to infinity; minus alpha times t.

cases.title: Greek case and variants
expected_content: Six terms in the authored order.
Upper/lower gamma differ; phi/varphi and epsilon/varepsilon remain distinguishable representations.
A pronunciation may be equivalent; do not require one universal spoken name for a variant.
cases.reader_task: Identify term positions 1, 2, 3 and 4 and whether 3 and 4 are distinct variants.
cases.expected_answer: Capital gamma, lowercase gamma, phi, variant phi; distinct variants.

cases.title: Quantum expectation value
expected_content: Left bra psi; middle hatted H; right ket psi.
The hat on H and both psi operands remain present.
cases.reader_task: Identify the middle operator including its accent.
cases.expected_answer: H with a hat.

cases.title: Physics package macros
expected_content: Bra phi followed by ket psi, plus the second partial derivative of f with respect to x.
The derivative order is 2, not 1; f and x remain operands.
cases.reader_task: Identify the derivative order and differentiation variable.
cases.expected_answer: Second order, with respect to x.

cases.title: Vector cross product
expected_content: F, v and B use bold mathematical notation; q is scalar notation.
Operator between v and B is cross product, not ordinary multiplication.
cases.reader_task: Identify the operation joining v and B.
cases.expected_answer: Cross product.

cases.title: Units and scientific notation
expected_content: Quantity is 3.00 times 10 to the 8 metres per second.
No reciprocal-unit or exponent change; retain authored precision in source representation.
cases.reader_task: Read the magnitude and unit.
cases.expected_answer: 3.00 times 10 to the eighth metres per second.

cases.title: Piecewise boundaries
expected_content: Two branches. x squared for x greater than or equal to zero; negative x for x less than zero.
The value x=0 belongs to the first branch only.
cases.reader_task: Which branch includes x equal to zero?
cases.expected_answer: The x squared branch.

cases.title: Aligned derivation and cross reference
expected_content: Two numbered aligned rows in order; distinct labels energy and mass.
References resolve to the correct rows, not both to one expression.
cases.reader_task: Follow the mass reference and identify the left side.
cases.expected_answer: E divided by c squared.

cases.title: Multiple inline equations
expected_content: Three inline expressions in order, with intervening prose intact.
Final expression is c=a+b, not c=3 substituted by a converter.
cases.reader_task: Read the paragraph continuously, then find the middle expression.
cases.expected_answer: b equals 2; all connecting prose remains available.

cases.title: Long expression and final sentinel
expected_content: Sixteen indexed terms, then the sentinel fraction 97q_end/(1+z^2).
Source math exceeds 500 characters; final term remains accessible and is not lost by summarization.
cases.reader_task: Locate the last numerator and denominator.
cases.expected_answer: Numerator 97 times q with subscript end; denominator 1 plus z squared.

cases.title: Authored ordered pair
expected_content: Author explicitly defines the notation as an ordered pair with first coordinate a and second coordinate b.
Do not infer an interval from appearance.
cases.reader_task: What meaning does the surrounding prose assign?
cases.expected_answer: An ordered pair; first a, second b.

cases.title: Authored open interval
expected_content: Author explicitly defines an open interval with endpoints a and b excluded.
Math glyphs match M17; context differs.
cases.reader_task: Are the endpoints included?
cases.expected_answer: Neither endpoint is included.

cases.title: Project dependencies and references
expected_content: Both dependency files resolve in project context.
Exactly one authored expression mc^2=E survives with its equation label.
Opening prose, included prose, reference and bibliography remain in reading order.
cases.reader_task: Follow the equation reference and identify the expanded macro.
cases.expected_answer: m times c squared; equation mc squared equals E.

cases.title: Diagram relationships
expected_content: Three labeled nodes A, B and C; directed edges A to B and A to C only.
Caption is intentionally incomplete as an alternative; counting nodes/arrows is insufficient.
cases.reader_task: Identify each directed edge and determine whether B connects to C.
cases.expected_answer: A to B and A to C; no B to C edge.

cases.title: Grouped data table
expected_content: Four data values with associations: Red/A=2, Red/B=5, Blue/A=7, Blue/B=11.
Trial groups A and B. Source has visual header cues but no explicit accessible header annotations.
cases.reader_task: Find the Blue sample in Trial B and identify its headers.
cases.expected_answer: 11; row Blue, column B under Trial.

cases.title: German language metadata
expected_content: German prose retained; v=3.
Document language should be German, not an unconditional English default.
cases.reader_task: Identify the document language and read the equation.
cases.expected_answer: German; v equals 3.

cases.title: Undefined macro negative control
expected_content: Undefined macro must remain explicitly unresolved, not silently converted into a trustworthy equation.
cases.reader_task: Confirm the diagnostic identifies unsupported source.
cases.expected_answer: Unresolved macro; no invented meaning.

cases.title: Missing included chapter
expected_content: Missing dependency identified; zero detected equations must not imply full document success.
cases.reader_task: Confirm missing source is visible as a failure.
cases.expected_answer: Missing chapters/absent.tex; document incomplete.

cases.title: Missing figure asset
expected_content: Missing image remains unresolved.
No filename-derived or invented description receives verified remediation credit.
cases.reader_task: Confirm no description claims to know unseen image content.
cases.expected_answer: Source image unavailable; human review required.

cases.title: Unbalanced fraction source
expected_content: Malformed math is reported explicitly.
A partial output file is not a successful fidelity result.
cases.reader_task: Confirm error remains visible and original source is retained.
cases.expected_answer: Malformed fraction; unresolved.
